description: This file defines a Java interface LocationDAO that specifies database access methods for location-related entities in the OpenMRS system, including CRUD operations for Location, LocationTag, and LocationAttributeType objects, as well as search and retrieval functions.

classes.name: LocationDAO
classes.description: Interface defining data access operations for location-related entities, including methods for CRUD operations, searching, and retrieval based on various criteria.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory for database connectivity.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Creates or updates a Location object in the database.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by its internal ID.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by its name.

methods.name: getAllLocations
methods.description: Retrieves all Location objects, with the option to include retired locations.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Finds locations matching name fragment, parent, attribute values, and retirement status, with pagination.

methods.name: deleteLocation
methods.description: Removes a Location from the database.

methods.name: saveLocationTag
methods.description: Creates or updates a LocationTag.

methods.name: getLocationTag
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag by its internal ID.

methods.name: getLocationTagByName
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag by its name.

methods.name: getAllLocationTags
methods.description: Retrieves all LocationTags, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getLocationTags
methods.description: Finds LocationTags matching a search string.

methods.name: deleteLocationTag
methods.description: Removes a LocationTag from the database.

methods.name: getLocationByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by its UUID.

methods.name: getLocationTagByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag by its UUID.

methods.name: getCountOfLocations
methods.description: Returns the count of locations matching a name fragment and retirement status.

methods.name: getRootLocations
methods.description: Retrieves top-level locations, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getAllLocationAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all location attribute types.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a location attribute type by its ID.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a location attribute type by UUID.

methods.name: saveLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Creates or updates a location attribute type.

methods.name: deleteLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Removes a location attribute type.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a location attribute by UUID.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a location attribute type by name.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAllTags
methods.description: Finds locations that have all specified tags, ignoring null values.
